headlines.title: Cornell students protest handling of alleged 2024 sexual assault
headlines.description: Students at Cornell University are protesting on campus over the handling of the alleged 2024 sexual assault. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa spoke with a sophomore who is calling for the resignation of administrators.

headlines.title: Supreme Court hears arguments in climate change case seeking to hold companies liable
headlines.description: The Supreme Court began its new term by hearing arguments in a case seeking to hold energy companies liable for damages caused by climate change. NBC News' Gary Grumbach has details on the cases presented and potential implications.

headlines.title: Mystery death in Russian lab
headlines.description: U.S. officials are closely monitoring a situation in Russia after a woman died last week. Authorities say she worked at a lab that studied the plague. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has the story.

headlines.title: Ford CEO says it's his company's responsibility to bring more affordable vehicles to the U.S.
headlines.description: Americans are still buying cars, but they're borrowing record amounts of money and taking on longer car loans to help make ends meet. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Ford CEO Jim Farley, who said his company has five more-affordable vehicles on the way.

headlines.title: Former 'American Idol' contestant sentenced to life in prison without parole for wife's murder
headlines.description: Caleb Flynn, a former Ohio pastor and "American Idol" contestant, was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole for the murder of his wife, Ashley Flynn. NBC News' Shaquille Brewster reports on their children's response as Caleb Flynn maintained his innocence.

headlines.title: Plea agreement hearing set for ex-CIA officer found with gold bars
headlines.description: David Rush has been in custody since his arrest in May, and his defense team had been working with federal prosecutors on a possible plea deal.

headlines.title: Trump Rallies for Republicans Ahead of Midterm Elections
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is making a major push in once-reliable Republican states as a new NBC News poll shows his party could be facing an uphill battle ahead of the midterm elections. It comes as new Trump ads, paid for by taxpayers, get prime-time air, some during football games. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: 3 takeaways from our new poll of Latino voters: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: How the shooting death of a Houston father is igniting Latino politics in Texas
headlines.description: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was killed on his way to work by ICE agents, who said he used his vehicle as a weapon. The community is demanding justice.

headlines.description: After a certain point in some states, there’s no way to hold a perpetrator accountable for sexual assaults.

headlines.title: Where you live matters when it comes to prosecuting rape suspects
headlines.description: A murderer can be convicted decades after committing the crime, because there is no statute of limitations on most homicides in America.
